If you wish to run 1A2 anyway:
- On slide 9, you'll have to closely watch which Clone Set
you are part of. This will be your clone group and side.
For instance, the player on 3 will be in the eastern clone group side.
The player on 1 will be on the western clone group side.

This is no longer Color Based.
- Furthermore, you'll have to count and keep track of the
clone order yourself. No longer are  Red and Blue first / Yellow and Purple second.

- Funnily enough, the final stacks will now be on colors Purple and Yellow.

Either marker set works fine. If you feel disadvantaged running 4A1, you can swap.
I found myself that this marker set helps keep track of which group is playing
in which half of the arena.

From what I know, not a single part of the fight needs the markers in specific spots
anyway, so doing this is not disadvantaging you in the earlier parts.

Changelog:
08/01:
- Changed tower debuff mechanic to Zenith uptime
- Changed from snake prio to a color-pair based solution
for tethers. Stacks swapped from clockwise to CCW
- Added 1A2 alternative

09/01:
- Added an extra slide for heuristic (slide 10)
- Some bugfixes

10/01:
- Fixed the near/far debuff icons that
were confusing people
- Also fixed defam and cleaves being old

11/01:
- Added VODS!!
- Inaccuracies fixed (thanks to the legends at
#encounters-general, you know who you are)

12/01:

CyclopsDragon for pointing this out!

Later these will resolve in order.

The mechanics on North/South will
resolve FIRST, going CW

EAST GROUP:

-> Stack on set 2.

To prepare for later mechanics,
we want clones groups to be
1 - Defamation
2 - Stack
3 - Stack
4 - Defamation

Swap between color pairs to
resolve this.

Alternate heuristic on the next
slide!

Alternative heuristic:
If North = Stack, Red and Blue pairs swap.
If North = Defam, Yellow and Purple pairs swap.

Or:
If Letters = Stacks, Red and Blue swap.
If Letters = Defams, Yellow and Purple swap.

Fun fact to make things easier:
From your initial clone position, you ALREADY can know what your job will
be when these tethers first resolve on slide 20.
The players on A2 and C4 willl always take the defam on their color.
The players on 1B and 3D will always take the stack on their color.
Furthermore, the players on Red and Blue will have their mechanics
resolved first on resolutions later (slide 20).

So if you are on 3, you already know that you need to take stack in your
color pair. If you understand this, you can completely forget about
the heuristic and just do it on your color pair yourself.

In VOD1 you can see the group marks the players with defamation to help
remind them what to do, but the marking is totally optional! (Don't AM)

The boss will do one final raidwide, and you are on for enrage!

Good luck!
